body:
Part of #273. Owner product acceptance remains required before the issue closes.

Renaming a node now repairs structurally understood references and edge endpoints in one editor update. Prose, literal JSON and opaque scripts remain unchanged. Dynamic or ambiguous references get explanations; known missing gate and visit identities block publication. Undo/redo, selection, held form input, draft/device tokens, protected Chat IDs and immutable published versions retain their existing boundaries.

GPT owns the domain/API repair and bounded source-analysis cache. Claude owns the editor design and implementation. [ADR-0075](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/decisions/ADR-0075-node-id-reference-repair.md) records the conservative repair boundary.

## Current integration and gates

Published head `ae8add8a791699e905540465b5ddf929d00c50eb`, tree `ea2dfcfd46f7d5ab79fd98414db214513d830b52`, includes actual merged main `a817e5ccb4fd598ca56089b97b4ce55e9cb6f58c` (PR #470). Integration commit `16aa9a2a` auto-merged product files; the only conflict was the QA attribute file, resolved by preserving both sides. The parent’s corrected rename-retry ownership is present in the combined editor/store. The final publication changes only evidence and the delivery register.

All 286 retained QA files for this publication were verified against staged and committed Git blobs. This includes 265 prior node-reference artifacts, a three-file first-CI-failure record and an 18-file [final naming audit/CI packet](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/qa/2026-11-14-loop-names-final/README.md); that packet preserves the already-merged parent’s evidence, including a lossless compressed reviewed diff, and adds no runtime scope.

This is a draft pending current integrated verification. The first CI run stopped at formatting two archived raw Markdown reports; build, process acceptance, typecheck and lint passed before that failure, and later Gates steps were skipped. The raw reports now use `.md.txt` names with unchanged bytes/hashes. [First failure and repair](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ae8add8a791699e905540465b5ddf929d00c50eb/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-references-ci-first/README.md). Refreshed focused tests, a matching build and independent native QA are queued. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43622692936) and [routing](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43622692920) are running. No current-head behavior result is inferred from the earlier results below. Formal scans are 0/3: opposite-family backend review, opposite-family UI review, and fresh whole-PR Astra max audit remain required. The three-total-scan cap and owner gate are unchanged.

## Retained verification

- Domain coverage passed 428/428 at historical checkpoint `207b3e5` (98.72% lines/95.56% branches). [Implementation/cache evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-implementation/README.md)
- Independent backend QA passed eleven public/domain/API groups, retaining its malformed first fixture and corrected attempt. [Backend QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-backend-independent/README.md)
- Phase-2 whole-web coverage passed 2,500 tests/201 files (98.51% lines/93.99% branches); 64 affected Edge cases passed. The held-input fixture was corrected to enter invalid JSON atomically without first saving an empty object; the corrected five-case rename suite passed with its original-value assertion intact. These browser tests use TypeScript-source API/in-memory FakeHarness. [Phase-2 evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-references-native/README.md) · [Fixture correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-references-held-fixture/README.md)
- Separate independent native QA at `700ce251` passed five scenarios across retained attempts 3 and 4, using Edge, compiled API and file SQLite: atomic rename/undo/redo, held input/device tokens, two immutable version-pinned executions, uncertainty versus real publication refusal, stale-tab recovery and protected Chat IDs. Eleven browser writes, zero uncaught page errors; 23 source hashes/1,054 build files matched before/after, with owned cleanup verified. [Independent native QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/ba3086b8c1df555ed6544e27cbdb2d6630e91948/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-independent-native/README.md)
- Paired 300-node Windows typing measurements showed no regression in that sample; both baseline and candidate exceeded 16.7 ms. Normal routing gates passed. This is no 60 fps, physical-device or cross-host performance claim.

Earlier evidence remains historical. New integration results, review dispositions and exact-head/target CI will be recorded before engineering delivery. No owner environment, provider session or stored content migration is involved.
